title: Adoption of Physical Measurement Maps, Spectroscopic Rank Resolution, and Macro-Model Isolation
decision: Formalized preflight reconciliation of PCr energy capacity (dG_ATP=54 kJ/mol for work vs dH_CK=21 kJ/mol for heat); downgraded Andersen & Saltin 1985 resting values to secondary literature extrapolations (5 male participants confirmed, not 8); adopted Table 2 published motor unit discharge characteristics (Hug 2021: GM 8.1, 8.1, 7.6, 12.2 Hz; GL 8.1, 8.2, 11.3, 14.0 Hz); classified biological participant count of reused Hug recordings as UNKNOWN; enforced strict separation between rater operators and subjects; prohibited concluding >99% oxidative contribution solely from single-muscle static PCr buffer ratio; and maintained TARGET-CPE45 as NOT EXTERNALLY VALIDATED with strict NO_GO on biological interventions.
rationale: Results and scientific validity corrections of Research Cycle 8 (EXP-0032..0036).

title: Adoption of Multi-Modal HD-sEMG Recruitment Model, Downgrade of Andersen & Saltin 1985 Resting Table, and Enforcement of Cross-Muscle Transfer Barrier
decision: Formalized preflight reconciliation of PCr energy capacity (dG_ATP=54 kJ/mol for work vs dH_CK=21 kJ/mol for heat); downgraded Andersen & Saltin 1985 resting values to secondary literature extrapolations; adopted high-density EMG motor unit decomposition and adipose morphometry as mandatory conditions for active volume identifiability; and maintained TARGET-CPE45 as NOT EXTERNALLY VALIDATED with strict NO_GO on biological interventions.
rationale: Scalar sEMG RMS has a >40-fold uncertainty span and inverts during fatigue; cross-muscle transfer degrades prediction RMSE by up to 189%; and calf PCr buffer accounts for <0.1% of a 2700 s whole-body endurance budget.

title: Scientific Freeze and Corrigendum of Rehman 2024 N=1 Empirical Benchmark: Reclassification of M2, M3 Blocked Status, Retraction of Universal pH >= 6.86, Separation of Conditional Reconstruction vs Prospective Prediction, and Preservation of TARGET-CPE45 Freeze
decision: Enacted EXP-0042 Scientific Corrigendum and scientific freeze on the Rehman et al. 2024 primary 31P-MRS benchmark: (1) Numerically reconciled all report values and markdown tables with canonical rehman2024_validation_results.json (PCr at 90s: 1920, 1291, 1277; nadir PCr: 1670, 1245, 1231; in-sample RMSE: M0=230.88/120.21/141.69, M1=26.05/15.73/14.70, M2=31.72/37.67/32.80; M0 R2 strictly negative); (2) Reclassified M2 from physiological bioenergetic ODE to CONSTRAINED_MONOEXPONENTIAL_BASELINE, barring claims of validated energy balance, O2 transport, ATP turnover, or motor control; (3) Classified full physiological model M3 as M3_NOT_EXECUTABLE_ON_AVAILABLE_OBSERVATIONS due to absence of mechanical workload, torque, muscle PCSA, and hemodynamics; (4) Distinguished Scenario A (CONDITIONAL_TRAJECTORY_RECONSTRUCTION, accepted with within-subject transfer M2 mean R2 = 0.8566) from Scenario B (PROSPECTIVE_PREDICTION, blocked as PROSPECTIVE_PREDICTION_BLOCKED_UNOBSERVED_DEPLETION_DYNAMICS); (5) Classified nominal timing (48s, 90s) as INFERRED_TIMING_ASSUMPTION and nadir as OBSERVED_SPECTRAL_MINIMUM_DISTINCT_FROM_MECHANICAL_STOP, retracting ischemic/hyperemic labels without blood flow measurements; (6) Formally retracted universal non-acidosis claim pH >= 6.86 as superseded (calculated range 6.7932 to 7.0228, Trial 1 min pH = 6.7932), retaining PH_CALIBRATION_PARTIAL without empirical fudge factors; (7) Strictly prohibited cross-subject Leave-One-Subject-Out (LOSO) on N=1 cohort; (8) Preserved TARGET-CPE45 as NOT EXTERNALLY VALIDATED with strict NO_GO on biological interventions.
rationale: Rigorous scientific integrity requires byte-for-byte reconciliation of reports with canonical data, honest mathematical classification of simplified recovery models, formal designation of unexecutable physiological components, and transparent retraction of unverified physiological claims (non-acidosis, ischemic lag) without empirical fudge factors.

title: Cycle 10 Multi-Subject Benchmark Adoption: Adoption of PhysioNet ACTES Cycloergometer (N=18) for Macroscopic Aerobic Coupling Validation, Integration of Allometric Mass Scaling, Ratification of REMAINING_BARRIERS_MATRIX, and Maintenance of TARGET-CPE45 and Biological Interventions Freeze
decision: Formally adopted the PhysioNet ACTES Cycloergometer dataset (SRC-0073, DOI 10.13026/2qs3-kh43, N=18 adolescent athletes, 52,062 synchronized records) as the primary multi-subject cardiorespiratory benchmark for SUBJECT-01: (1) Validated macroscopic aerobic coupling (P_mech -> pulmonary VO2) and Phase II response kinetics (tau = 35 s) under strict Leave-One-Subject-Out (LOSO) cross-validation with frozen parameters, achieving out-of-sample R2 = 0.7371 +/- 0.1770 with body-mass allometric scaling; (2) Overcame the N=1 single-subject bottleneck of Rehman 2024; (3) Ratified REMAINING_BARRIERS_MATRIX, formalizing that macroscopic VO2 does NOT identify or validate localized intracellular phosphates ([PCr], [Pi], [ATP]), cytosolic pH, motor unit recruitment order, or quadriceps PCSA; (4) Maintained TARGET-CPE45 as NOT EXTERNALLY VALIDATED; (5) Maintained biological interventions as strictly NO_GO.
rationale: Multi-subject experimental validation breaks the single-subject limitation while maintaining rigorous epistemic boundaries preventing unjustified claims of microscopic intracellular model validation.

title: Cycle 11 Multi-Modality CPET Expansion: Adoption of Factorial Model Nomenclature, Rectification of Efficiency Identifiability Statuses, Adoption of Malaga Treadmill Benchmark (N=992 tests, N=857 subjects), and Ratification of Cross-Modality Transfer Barrier (NEG-0037)
decision: Formally ratified the scientific and metrological updates of Cycle 10/11: (1) Adopted standardized macroscopic factorial model nomenclature (M0 Null Mean -> M1 Static Linear without Mass -> M2 Static Linear with Mass -> M3 Dynamic First-Order ODE -> M4 Allometric Dynamic First-Order ODE); (2) Rectified parameter identifiability definitions: established that linear regression slope beta1 identifies incremental delta efficiency (eta_delta = 1 / (beta1 * 348.33)), while gross efficiency eta_gross(t) = P(t) / E_met(t) is workload-dependent (0% at rest to ~24% at peak) and cannot be equated to slope beta1; verified Phase II delay tau via nested subject-level CV (tau = 35 s); documented metrological discrepancy between PhysioNet ACTES HTML (mL/min) and raw CSV bytes (L/min); documented heterogeneous linear mass scaling degradation in 7/18 subjects; (3) Adopted the PhysioNet Malaga Treadmill CPET dataset (SRC-0074, DOI 10.13026/7ezk-j442, N=992 tests, N=857 subjects, 575,087 observations) as the independent locomotion benchmark: 5-fold cross-validation confirms cardiorespiratory kinetics generalizability (M4 R2 = 0.6712, RMSE = 404.5 mL/min); (4) Empirically confirmed substrate oxidation and the oxycaloric equivalent distribution (mean c_ox = 21.37 kJ/L O2, matching the nominal 20.9 kJ/L assumption within 2.26%); (5) Ratified negative result NEG-0037 establishing the cross-modality barrier (cycling efficiency parameters do not transfer directly to running locomotion without biomechanical locomotion modeling); (6) Maintained TARGET-CPE45 as NOT EXTERNALLY VALIDATED and biological interventions strictly NO_GO.
rationale: Ensures mathematical precision in efficiency terminology, guards against test leakage via nested CV, expands empirical cardiorespiratory validation to whole-body running locomotion across 857 participants, and establishes modality specificity boundaries.

title: Cycle 11 Scientific Corrigendum: Subject-Level GroupKFold Validation, Efficiency Identifiability Rectification, Oxycaloric Audit, and Ad-Hoc Cross-Modality Reclassification
decision: Formally ratified the Cycle 11 scientific corrigendum and subject-level validation requirements: (1) Replaced test-level random splitting with deterministic GroupKFold(groups=subject_id, n_splits=5) for the PhysioNet Malaga treadmill dataset (N=846 unique independent participants, N=981 valid incremental tests), guaranteeing intersection(train_subjects, val_subjects) == empty_set across all folds; retained legacy test-level split as an explicit benchmark labeled SUBJECT_LEAKAGE_RISK_NOT_GROUPED; (2) Corrected apparent delta efficiency arithmetic in ACTES: population slope beta1 = 0.007657 L/min/W yields apparent unlagged ramp slope eta_apparent = 1 / (beta1 * 348.33) ~ 37.49% (NOT 25.5%); formally established that true steady-state delta efficiency is DELTA_EFFICIENCY_NOT_IDENTIFIABLE_FROM_UNLAGGED_RAMP because ACTES lacks multi-stage constant-load steady states; (3) Reclassified NEG-0037 as AD_HOC_CROSS_MODAL_MAPPING_FAILURE while preserving the empirical error of the formula, and classified physical cross-modal transfer as PHYSICAL_CROSS_MODAL_TRANSFER_NOT_IDENTIFIABLE due to lack of measured running mechanical power in treadmill CPET; (4) Audited oxycaloric equivalent: classified VO2, VCO2, RER as MEASURED, c_ox as DERIVED_MODEL_DEPENDENT, and non-steady-state substrate oxidation as NOT INDEPENDENTLY VALIDATED; established that 46.8% RER > 1 reflects non-metabolic respiratory buffering, not carbohydrate oxidation > 100%; (5) Logged open issue ISS-0020 tracking the license divergence between packaged CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 and PhysioNet Health Data License 1.5.0; (6) Maintained TARGET-CPE45 as NOT EXTERNALLY VALIDATED and biological interventions strictly NO_GO.
rationale: Eliminates biological group leakage in multi-test CPET cohorts, corrects mathematical calculations in efficiency parameters, rectifies epistemic classifications of indirect calorimetry under non-steady-state exercise, and enforces physical identifiability boundaries.

title: Ratification of Human Muscle Biomechanical Constraints, Variable Ontology, and Augmentation Architecture Prioritization
decision: Formally ratified the Cycle 12 human skeletal muscle force, activation decoupling, and fatigue biomechanical validation audit on Bird et al. (2026) multi-modal study (SRC-0076, Dryad DOI 10.5061/dryad.sbcc2frmh): (1) Adopted the observed vs derived variable ontology strictly differentiating directly measured physical quantities (dynamometer torque, angle, angular velocity, sEMG, fascicle length/velocity/pennation, radar reflections) from derived variables (moment arm, normalized stress, MVC fraction) and unobserved quantities (single-muscle Newtons, intracellular phosphates, motor unit discharge rates); (2) Established the Four-Tier Model Taxonomy strictly separating author-reported radar models (LSTM R2=0.988 under intra-participant CV) from SUBJECT-01 models, marking empirical status on raw arrays as NOT_INDEPENDENTLY_VALIDATED_ON_RAW_ARRAYS_PENDING_ACQUISITION while raw .mat and .xlsx files are pending acquisition due to Dryad anti-bot gating; (3) Audited physical constraints: reclassified specific tension (25-30 N/cm2), patellar tendon forces (5.5-8.4 kN), tendon strain limit (6-8%), safety factor (<1.5), muscle volume (10-15%), and diffusion limit (>200 um) as literature-derived benchmarks unmeasured in Bird 2026; corrected the concurrent training trade-off to the AMPK-mTORC1 Molecular Interference Effect, prohibiting misattribution to Henneman's Size Principle; (4) Documented data leakage and pseudoreplication controls: noted that author models lacked cross-subject LOSO across N=6 and that 16 conditions reflect repeated trials of 6 subjects (not 96 independent people); (5) Ratified negative result NEG-0038 establishing dynamic proxy decoupling, net joint moment indeterminacy, and incommensurability between 20-minute submaximal fatigue and 45-minute continuous extreme endurance (TARGET-CPE45); (6) Retained theoretical dynamic model hierarchy: M4 Multiscale (projected R2 = 0.748 +/- 0.062, NRMSE = 8.9%) and M3 Hill FLV (projected R2 = 0.612 +/- 0.084) outperform static models; documented small-sample uncertainty for N=6 (R2 95% CI [0.68, 0.81]); (7) Retained neuromuscular fatigue compensation (+26 +/- 15% activation increase at 45% MVC, p < 0.001) and M2 biophysical fatigue simulation baseline (projected R2 = 0.812, RMSE = 5.9%); (8) Prioritized Augmentation Architecture A (biological enhancement) as the primary grounded path while documenting unresolved barriers; retained Architectures B and C as blocked; (9) Maintained TARGET-CPE45 as NOT EXTERNALLY VALIDATED and biological interventions strictly NO_GO.
rationale: Transitions SUBJECT-01 from macroscopic cardiorespiratory models to in vivo muscular biomechanics while enforcing rigorous epistemic distinctions, four-tier taxonomy, physical constraints audit, sample size caveats, and strict safety freezes.

title: Strategic Reorientation: Disqualification of Architecture B, Freezing of Architecture C, and Prioritization of Architecture A with Tendon/Thermal Roadmaps
decision: Formally adopted the Cycle 13 strategic reorientation and evidence audit: (1) Disqualified Architecture B (Supplemental Bioengineered Muscle) as NO_GO due to acute myofascial compartment syndrome, microvascular ischemia, and enthesis shear; (2) Placed Architecture C (Internal Biohybrid Actuation) on HOLD / BREAKTHROUGH-DEPENDENT due to internal cavity heat rejection ceilings (400-800 W) and electrochemical battery mass penalties inside intact limbs; (3) Approved Architecture A (Native Biological Enhancement) as PRIMARY_RECOMMENDED_DIRECTION (CONDITIONAL POTENTIAL); (4) Ratified the 12-week Master Roadmap (Cycles 14-18) focusing on multi-joint kinematic chains, tendon-enthesis FEA stress limits, and 3D Penne's bioheat dissipation; (5) Placed PR #9 on CONDITIONAL HOLD pending bundle removal and thermal re-audit; (6) Ratified experiment EXP-0046, finding FND-0046, and negative result NEG-0040.

title: Adoption of Cycle 19 Biomechanical Baselines: Human Specific Tension Identification, Isomass Scaling Trade-offs, Tendon S-N Fatigue Envelope, and Commissioning of EXP-0061 Multi-Joint Architecture
decision: Formally adopted the findings of Research Cycle 19: (1) Established empirical in vivo quadriceps specific tension sigma = 27.22 +/- 4.84 N/cm2 (95% CI [25.09, 29.34]) as the sex-invariant physiological baseline for human functional strength; (2) Adopted the 1-parameter physics PCSA model (M2, LOSO R2 = 0.6758) as the parsimonious baseline over parameter-rich models; (3) Ratified negative result NEG-0056 establishing the isomass architectural trade-off (+25.2% isometric force via pennation sacrifices -21.7% v_max and ROM); (4) Calibrated the human tendon Wöhler fatigue power law (B = 8.45) and confirmed that unadapted +20% force reduces cyclic fatigue life by -86.7% (retention 0.133x) despite static SF = 2.06; (5) Established the 15% tendon hypertrophy / 10% UTS adaptation threshold required to preserve mechanical durability; (6) Ratified negative result NEG-0057 (modulus stiffening without hypertrophy fails fatigue protection); (7) Maintained core program invariants: TARGET-CPE45 = NOT EXTERNALLY VALIDATED, BIOLOGICAL INTERVENTIONS = NO_GO, STRENGTH +20% = NOT VALIDATED; (8) Commissioned Phase VI Experiment EXP-0061 (multi-joint closed kinematic chain power transmission and dynamic tendon safety under rapid dF/dt).
rationale: Transitions SUBJECT-01 from molecular MTJ audits to rigorous, reproducible biomechanical quantification of human strength and tendon safety limits on empirical datasets.

title: Adoption of Independent Functional Mechanics Validation, Rectification of Cycle 19 Mathematical Contradictions, and Ratification of the Isomass Power Penalty and Tendon Iso-Durability Invariants
decision: Formally adopted the comprehensive independent re-validation of SUBJECT-01 functional mechanics: (1) Rectified the EXP-0059 double-cosine scaling artifact, establishing corrected in vivo quadriceps specific tension sigma = 26.41 +/- 4.70 N/cm2 (95% CI [24.21, 28.61]); (2) Established that specific tension is a model-dependent parameter (95% Monte Carlo credibility interval [17.58, 44.98] N/cm2, NEG-0058), not an isolated individual measurement; (3) Reclassified sex equivalence via TOST, confirming equivalence within +/- 20% (p = 0.0169) while rejecting claims of strict fine-scale biological equivalence at 10% (NEG-0059); (4) Ratified the Isomass Power Penalty discovery (FND-0062), proving that increasing pennation under constant muscle volume increases static torque (+25.20%) but reduces peak mechanical power (-1.98%), functional shortening speed (-21.71%), and active joint ROM (-21.71%); (5) Reconciled the tendon fatigue mathematical contradiction between semi-log (k = -10.808, -86.67% loss) and power-law formulations (B = 8.45, -78.58% loss; B = 13.27, -91.11% loss); (6) Corrected Case 2C adapted tensile stress arithmetic to 40.13 MPa (disproving the erroneous 34.78 MPa claim); (7) Ratified the exact Tendon Iso-Durability Conservation Invariant (FND-0063): (1 + Delta_CSA) * (1 + Delta_UTS) >= lambda_F; (8) Adopted the Multi-System Enhancement Strategy (Strategy 2) achieving +21.9% torque, -1.7% speed preservation, +19.8% peak power, and 1.35x fatigue life retention; (9) Reclassified NEG-0057 to uniaxial force-controlled regimes while documenting the detrimental effects of tendon stiffening in strain-controlled and elastic catapult functions; (10) Maintained core program invariants: TARGET-CPE45 = NOT EXTERNALLY VALIDATED, BIOLOGICAL INTERVENTIONS = NO_GO, +20% STRENGTH = THEORETICALLY_FEASIBLE_WITH_COORDINATED_TENDON_ADAPTATION (unvalidated in vivo).
rationale: Closes all outstanding mathematical and epistemic ambiguities from Cycle 19 and establishes a unified, rigorous, and verified biomechanical foundation for human functional augmentation.

title: Completion of PLAN.md and MASTER_ROADMAP.md Computational Programme: Architecture A Canonical Specification, Closed-Chain EXP-0061, Enthesis dF/dt & Heterochrony EXP-0062, Thermal Envelope EXP-0063, and Master Integration EXP-0064
decision: Formally ratified EXP-0061..0064, FND-0064..0067, NEG-0060..0062, and the Canonical Specification of Architecture A: (1) Recorded Outcome 4 (DATA_BLOCKED) for external bilateral isometric leg press cohort transfer pending open individual data release, while closing 3-DOF closed-chain compatibility mechanics via linear programming without pseudoinverse shortcuts and auditing single-joint DPValid paired cluster bootstrap precision (Outcome 3: INCONCLUSIVE at N=20); (2) Quantified viscoelastic deep-layer enthesis shear stress concentration under dF/dt = 20,000 N/s and placed TARGET-ADAPT25 on HOLD_RATE_LIMITED_BY_COLLAGEN_SYNTHESIS unless muscle gain is paced to FND-0063 tendon adaptation (H2); (3) Quantified 4-layer cylindrical Pennes bioheat intermittent duty-cycle bounds over 2700 s and confirmed AEGIS-01 (-25.0% duty capacity at 360 W) remains in CONDITIONAL_HOLD; (4) Maintained all hard program invariants: TARGET-CPE45 = NOT EXTERNALLY VALIDATED, BIOLOGICAL INTERVENTIONS = NO_GO, +20% STRENGTH = THEORETICALLY_FEASIBLE_WITH_COORDINATED_TENDON_ADAPTATION (unvalidated in vivo).
rationale: Completes the four computational and protocol pillars of PLAN.md and MASTER_ROADMAP.md while preserving strict separation between empirical human benchmarks and MODEL_ONLY multi-physics simulations.

title: Adopt equal-work control and adjudicate current programme evidence
decision: Adopt EXP-0065/0066 and their scoped outcomes. Require equal-work controls before attributing a thermal gain to temporal structure. The N=21 intermittent snapshot in EXP-0063/0064 is Chmura SRC-0035, not ACTES. EXP-0062 H1 changes reciprocal muscle time scale by 33 1/3% and also changes tendon inputs, so it is not the registered ADAPT25 contrast. Archive replay does not settle functional transfer. A remains CONDITIONAL POTENTIAL; coupled prediction and whole-profile external demonstration remain HOLD pending admissible linked observations. Maintain FORCE20 unvalidated, ADAPT25 HOLD and CPE45 NOT EXTERNALLY VALIDATED; retain B/C and AEGIS decisions and BIOLOGICAL INTERVENTIONS NO_GO.
rationale: Heat contrast depends on unmatched work, frozen thermal transfer failed against persistence in light cycling, and no newly audited source covers the joint outcomes.

title: Admit scoped bilateral isometric force cohort with geometric limitations
decision: Admit SRC-0090 and EXP-0087 for narrow cross-protocol baseline force and within-cohort trajectory assessment. Retain DATA_BLOCKED for exact EXP-0061 protocol and individualized geometry, FORCE20 and ADAPT25 unvalidated, CPE45 NOT EXTERNALLY VALIDATED, whole-system HOLD and interventions NO_GO.
rationale: Published individual force values support a relevant partial comparison but 110-degree task, 11 men, absent individual mass/geometry and parallel control do not establish individual model validity or architecture effects.

title: Limit force-chain posture claims pending explicit hip geometry
decision: Record FND-0086 and NEG-0071. Retain EXP-0061 and dependent outputs as fixed-chord static model scenarios; do not treat passed hip angle as an evaluated independent input or 110-degree re-run as full posture validation. Add ISS-0029 and require measured, mechanically coherent hip/trunk geometry before robustness claims. Maintain A conditional, FORCE20/ADAPT25 and CPE45 unvalidated, whole-system HOLD and interventions NO_GO.
rationale: The hip argument is never read and altering it changes none of the outputs; the 110-degree rerun on the previously viewed Santos cohort does not establish better prediction.
